# Double-click action<AvailableFrom v="4.0.546" />

Choose what happens when double-clicking a layer, effect, or property in Remotion Studio. `open-in-editor` (default) opens its source code. `open-in-agent` opens the preferred coding agent. `copy-context` copies the item name, file path, and line number to the clipboard. Change the project setting in Settings → Apps.

## CLI flag

```text
--double-click-action <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setDoubleClickAction('copy-context');
```
